topics.review_note: v2: Paper 2019-2025 chọn bởi coding agent từ arXiv. Không lấy từ output hệ thống. 6/12 paper này hệ thống đã retrieve (expected), 6 paper còn lại là những gì hệ thống bỏ sót trong vùng corpus nó có thể access.

paper_relevance.title: Strategies for Pre-training Graph Neural Networks
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Pre-training GNN cho molecular property prediction và protein function prediction — state-of-the-art +9.4% ROC-AUC. Foundational work về transfer learning cho molecular GNN. Published 2019, widely cited từ 2020.

paper_relevance.title: ChemBERTa: Large-Scale Self-Supervised Pretraining for Molecular Property Prediction
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: ChemBERTa áp dụng BERT pre-training trên SMILES cho molecular property prediction, đối sánh trực tiếp với GNN approach trên MoleculeNet. Cần trong review để compare graph vs sequence representation.

paper_relevance.title: RetroGNN: Approximating Retrosynthesis by Graph Neural Networks for De Novo Drug Design
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: RetroGNN dùng GNN để xấp xỉ retrosynthesis planning, bias de novo generation về phân tử có thể tổng hợp. Directly addresses Generative models theme với drug-like constraint. Hệ thống đã retrieve paper này.

paper_relevance.title: Directional Message Passing for Molecular Graphs (DimeNet)
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: DimeNet cải tiến MPNN với directional message passing và spherical harmonics — outperforms 76% trên MD17, 31% trên QM9. Cần trong review cho Molecular representation và Property prediction themes.

paper_relevance.title: Advanced Graph and Sequence Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction and Drug Discovery (AdvProp)
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: #1 ROC-AUC và PRC-AUC trên AICures COVID-19 challenge. Combine graph + sequence neural networks. Directly addresses tất cả expected themes. Hệ thống đã retrieve.

paper_relevance.title: MoCL: Data-driven Molecular Fingerprint via Knowledge-aware Contrastive Learning from Molecular Graph
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: MoCL dùng contrastive learning trên molecular graph cho drug-related GNN pre-training, tích hợp domain knowledge ở cả local và global level. Addresses Molecular representation với self-supervised learning approach.

paper_relevance.title: CandidateDrug4Cancer: An Open Molecular Graph Learning Benchmark on Drug Discovery for Cancer
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Benchmark dataset cho cancer drug discovery với 54869 drug molecules và 29 cancer targets. Drug-target interaction prediction using graph neural networks. Hệ thống đã retrieve.

paper_relevance.title: GraphCL-DTA: a graph contrastive learning with molecular semantics for drug-target binding affinity prediction
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Graph contrastive learning cho drug-target binding affinity prediction kết hợp molecular semantics. Directly relevant với drug discovery application. Hệ thống đã retrieve.

paper_relevance.title: HiGraphDTI: Hierarchical Graph Representation Learning for Drug-Target Interaction Prediction
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Hierarchical GNN cho drug-target interaction prediction. State-of-the-art trong DTI. Hệ thống đã retrieve.

paper_relevance.title: GROVER: Self-Supervised Graph Transformer on Large-Scale Molecular Data
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: GROVER — self-supervised graph transformer pre-trained on 10M unlabeled molecules (ZINC + ChEMBL). Node/edge-level and graph-level pretext tasks. SOTA trên MoleculeNet properties.

paper_relevance.title: Pushing the Boundaries of Molecular Representation for Drug Discovery with the Graph Attention Mechanism (AttentiveFP)
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: AttentiveFP — graph attention network with super-graph node cho molecular property prediction. SOTA trên Lipophilicity, ESOL, FreeSolv. Widely used baseline.

paper_relevance.title: Uni-Mol: A Universal 3D Molecular Representation Learning Framework
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Uni-Mol — 3D Transformer pre-trained on 209M molecules and 3M proteins. SE(3)-equivariant 3D representation. SOTA trên quantum chemistry, drug-protein binding prediction.

paper_relevance.title: DrugGEN: Target-Specific De Novo Design of Drug Candidate Molecules with Graph Generative Deep Adversarial Networks
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: DrugGEN — GAN-based generative model for target-specific drug candidate design. Directly addresses Generative models theme for drug discovery applications.

paper_relevance.title: Molecular Graph Generation via Geometric Deep Learning
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: 3D-aware molecular graph generation using geometric deep learning — SE(3)-equivariant generative model for drug-like molecule design. Combines molecular representation and generative themes.

paper_relevance.title: Graph Neural Networks in Modern AI-aided Drug Discovery
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Review toàn diện về GNN trong drug discovery: molecular property prediction, virtual screening, molecular generation, synthesis planning. Covers tất cả 3 expected themes. Hệ thống chưa retrieve.

paper_relevance.title: A Survey of Graph Neural Networks for Drug Discovery: Recent Developments and Challenges
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Survey toàn diện về GNN cho drug discovery: molecular property prediction, drug-target interaction, drug repositioning, new drug design. Covers tất cả 3 expected themes. Hệ thống đã retrieve.

topics.reference_answer: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have become the dominant paradigm for AI-driven drug discovery by natively processing molecular graphs, capturing both atomic features and bonding topology. Three primary application areas define the field: (1) Molecular representation: Pre-training strategies (Hu et al. 2020) enable transfer learning; contrastive approaches (MoCL, 2021) incorporate domain knowledge; SMILES-based transformers (ChemBERTa, 2020) provide complementary sequence representations; directional message passing (DimeNet, 2020) improves geometric modeling. (2) Property prediction: Ensemble approaches combining graph and sequence representations (AdvProp, 2020) achieve state-of-the-art; specialized benchmarks (CandidateDrug4Cancer, 2022) provide realistic evaluation; drug-target interaction methods (GraphCL-DTA 2023, HiGraphDTI 2024) address binding affinity prediction. (3) Generative models: GNN-based retrosynthesis (RetroGNN, 2020) enables synthesizability-constrained de novo design. Recent surveys (Berry & Cheng 2025; Zhang et al. 2025) confirm GNNs cover molecular property prediction, virtual screening, molecular generation, and synthesis planning. Key open challenges: data scarcity, interpretability, clinical validation, and generalization to novel chemical spaces.
